name: Hotel Vista Allegra KG
beschreibung: Hotel Vista Allegra KG is located in the center of Ischgl, just moments from the Silvretta cable car valley station and the lively pedestrian precinct. Operated as a premier Hotel Garni, it serves a wholesome gourmet breakfast buffet each morning. The guest rooms and contemporary self-catering apartments harmonize alpine charm with modern conveniences. A tranquil on-site wellness area includes a Finnish sauna, steam bath, and relaxation zone. Ski enthusiasts benefit from direct access to the world-renowned Silvretta Arena slopes, while summer visitors enjoy immediate access to Paznaun’s scenic hiking and biking networks.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Garni in Ischgl featuring double rooms, apartments, and wellness facilities near the Silvretta cable car.
